title: ライブ・ア・ライブ
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written

The kana by their order in the font, held against the screen; the signs and kanji read in play: the codes the script passed, and the characters that came up in the sentence on screen. No second reader has read the font
Played from power-on: the openings of three chapters (SF, Bakumatsu, Near Future)
What the script said in play agreed with the lines read off 54 of 54 pictures, over 4 scenes. No screen without text was among them; a question's answers come out as rows of its text
notes: Read by the script games/sfc/SFC-A07624CD.lua. The game keeps no message in work RAM: it draws from the script in the cartridge, and a pointer says where it has got to. So the script reads the cartridge (0xC00000 on) and needs a host that gives it. One byte a character but for kanji (two, from 0x1A to 0x1F); kana by rule, the rest by the table, which has the 77 kanji met in three chapters' openings: others come out as U+FFFD. Who speaks, menus and fights aren't read.
